notes: The confidence threshold and image-quality cutoffs are configurable starting points, not scientifically validated limits. Select confidence_threshold using a separate labeled validation set: compare coverage, per-class error among accepted predictions, and the cost of missed/uncertain cases across candidate thresholds. Do not tune on the test set. This classifier has no validated out-of-distribution or non-maize rejection mechanism.
ood_guidance: Current tested rejection is limited to empty paths, missing files, corrupt images, and unsupported extensions. For genuine OOD handling, collect independent labeled in-scope and out-of-scope examples (including other crops and unrelated objects), calibrate an embedding-distance or energy-based detector on a separate validation set, then measure false acceptance/rejection on a held-out external set. Do not enable OOD rejection or describe the model as detecting non-maize until that evaluation has been completed.
